title: SSMCGM-Stream: A Streaming State-Space Model for Personalized Diabetes Management
abstract: arXiv:2610.28976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous glucose monitoring supports diabetes management but requires forecasting models that are accurate, interpretable, and efficient enough for real-time deployment. We present SSMCGM-Stream, a streaming state-space model that maintains a personalized hidden state updated with each incoming glucose reading to provide constant-time forecasting, physiologically structured counterfactual reasoning, and interpretable forecasts through hidden-state attribution. Built on this foundation, SSMCGM-Agent delivers risk-aware, natural-language decision support by translating forecasts, explanations, and counterfactuals into grounded recommendations through a guarded language-model interface. Evaluated on the T1DEXI cohort, SSMCGM-Stream achieves forecasting performance comparable to strong neural baselines while substantially reducing computational cost, enabling continuous on-device diabetes decision support.

translated_title: SSMCGM-Stream：一种用于个性化糖尿病管理的流式状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 连续血糖监测为糖尿病管理提供了支持，但需要准确、可解释且足够高效以实现实时部署的预测模型。我们提出了SSMCGM-Stream，这是一种流式状态空间模型，通过每次接收到的血糖读数更新来维护个性化的隐藏状态，从而提供恒定时间的预测、具有生理结构的反事实推理，以及通过隐藏状态归因实现的可解释预测。在此基础上，SSMCGM-Agent通过一个受保护的语言模型接口，将预测结果、解释和反事实分析转化为有据可依的建议，提供风险感知的自然语言决策支持。在T1DEXI队列上的评估表明，SSMCGM-Stream的预测性能与强大的神经基线模型相当，同时大幅降低了计算成本，使持续的设备端糖尿病决策支持成为可能。
tldr: 提出了流式状态空间模型SSMCGM-Stream，通过实时更新个性化隐藏状态实现高效、可解释的血糖预测，并结合SSMCGM-Agent提供设备端自然语言糖尿病决策支持，性能与神经基线相当而计算成本大幅降低。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SSMCGM-Stream, a streaming state-space model that maintains a personalized hidden state for constant-time, interpretable glucose forecasting, paired with SSMCGM-Agent for on-device natural-language diabetes decision support, matching neural baselines at substantially lower computational cost.
